## Problem

Is your feature request related to a problem? A clear and concise description of
what the problem is. For example: "I'm always frustrated when [...]".

## Proposed solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen and how it would fit
into the existing API.

## Alternatives considered

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you have
considered.

## Additional context

Add any other context, references, or screenshots about the feature request here.
